weekly_missing_rule: observed indicator if present; otherwise fixed station-calendar-month observed exceedance probability
weekly_preprocessing: OLS cubic trend plus 3 annual harmonics; fitted separately to each native surrogate; index IAAFT acts on observed residuals
primary_statistic: Ferro-Segers intervals estimator q=0.90, clipped to [0,1]
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Yekutieli q=0.05 separately for native and index station-level p-values
primary_across_station_summary: region-clustered paired asymmetry of index-only versus native-only
primary_mechanism_summary: Spearman association of frozen N_eff,p with log(index-null SD/native-null SD), with 2000 region-cluster bootstrap resamples
secondary_equalization: month-specific empirical thresholds giving uniform monthly event probability pbar = mean_m p_m; scientific fixed threshold remains primary
note: No station-level surrogate results were inspected before this protocol was written.
